# Moul UI (`@moul-dev/ui`) — Complete Documentation & Component API Reference

> Moul UI is an accessible, zero-runtime React component library built with React Aria Components and StyleX.

## 1. Overview & Quick Start

### Installation
```bash
bun add @moul-dev/ui
# or
npm install @moul-dev/ui
```

### Setup Stylesheet & ThemeProvider
```tsx
import '@moul-dev/ui/style.css';
import { ThemeProvider } from '@moul-dev/ui';

export function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider colorScheme="light dark">
      {children}
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

---

## 2. AI Agent Rules & Conventions

1. **Imports**: Always import components directly from `@moul-dev/ui`.
2. **Events**: Use `onPress` instead of `onClick` on `<Button>`, `<Link>`, and interactive triggers.
3. **Selection**:
   - Single item: `isSelected`, `defaultSelected`, `onChange`.
   - Collections: `selectedKey`, `defaultSelectedKey`, `selectedKeys`, `onSelectionChange`.
4. **Dialogs & Overlays**: Controlled with `isOpen`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`.
5. **Accessibility**: Always provide an `aria-label` when rendering icon-only buttons.
6. **Compound Components**: Use subcomponents for compound structures (e.g. `<Modal>`, `<ModalOverlay>`, `<ModalDialog>`, `<ModalHeader>`, `<ModalBody>`, `<ModalFooter>`).

---

## 3. Buttons & Actions

### Button
Interactive button supporting multiple semantic variants, sizes, and pending states.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@moul-dev/ui';

// Usage:
<Button variant="primary" size="md" onPress={() => console.log('Clicked')}>
  Save Changes
</Button>

<Button variant="outline" size="sm" isDisabled>
  Disabled
</Button>

<Button variant="danger" isPending>
  Deleting...
</Button>
```

**Props**:
- `variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'danger' | 'danger-soft'` (default: `'primary'`)
- `size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'` (default: `'md'`)
- `isPending?: boolean`
- `isDisabled?: boolean`
- `onPress?: (e: PressEvent) => void`
- `aria-label?: string`

---

### ButtonGroup
Groups multiple buttons in horizontal or vertical orientation, with optional attached borders.

```tsx
import { Button, ButtonGroup } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<ButtonGroup orientation="horizontal" isAttached>
  <Button variant="outline">Day</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Week</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Month</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

---

### ToggleButton & ToggleButtonGroup
Allows toggling one or multiple binary choices.

```tsx
import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<ToggleButton isSelected={isPinned} onChange={setIsPinned} variant="outline">
  📌 Pin
</ToggleButton>

<ToggleButtonGroup
  selectionMode="multiple"
  selectedKeys={selectedStyles}
  onSelectionChange={setSelectedStyles}
>
  <ToggleButton id="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton id="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton id="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

---

### Link
Accessible anchor link component.

```tsx
import { Link } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Link href="/dashboard" variant="primary" underline="hover">
  Go to Dashboard &rarr;
</Link>
```

---

### Kbd
Keyboard key visual indicator badge.

```tsx
import { Kbd } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<p>Press <Kbd>Ctrl</Kbd> + <Kbd>S</Kbd> to save your work.</p>
```

---

## 4. Form & Inputs

### TextField & TextArea
Text inputs with built-in accessibility, labels, helper text, and validation.

```tsx
import { TextField, TextArea } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<TextField
  label="Full Name"
  placeholder="Jordan Smith"
  description="Enter your legal first and last name."
  isRequired
  value={name}
  onChange={setName}
/>

<TextArea
  label="Bio"
  placeholder="Write a short bio..."
  rows={4}
  maxLength={500}
/>
```

---

### NumberField & SearchField
```tsx
import { NumberField, SearchField } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<NumberField
  label="Seats"
  minValue={1}
  maxValue={50}
  defaultValue={5}
  step={1}
/>

<SearchField
  label="Search Team"
  placeholder="Filter by name or email..."
  onSubmit={(q) => console.log('Search:', q)}
/>
```

---

### Select
Accessible dropdown select list.

```tsx
import { Select, SelectItem, SelectSection, SelectPopover, SelectValue } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Select
  label="Role"
  placeholder="Select role..."
  selectedKey={role}
  onSelectionChange={(key) => setRole(key as string)}
>
  <SelectItem id="admin" textValue="Administrator">Administrator</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem id="member" textValue="Team Member">Team Member</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem id="viewer" textValue="Viewer">Viewer</SelectItem>
</Select>
```

---

### ComboBox
Searchable autocomplete combobox.

```tsx
import { ComboBox, ComboBoxItem } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<ComboBox
  label="Country"
  placeholder="Type to filter..."
  onSelectionChange={(key) => setCountry(key as string)}
>
  <ComboBoxItem id="us">United States</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem id="ca">Canada</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem id="uk">United Kingdom</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem id="de">Germany</ComboBoxItem>
</ComboBox>
```

---

### Checkbox & CheckboxGroup
```tsx
import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Checkbox isSelected={agree} onChange={setAgree}>
  I accept the license agreement
</Checkbox>

<CheckboxGroup
  label="Permissions"
  value={permissions}
  onChange={setPermissions}
>
  <Checkbox value="read">Read</Checkbox>
  <Checkbox value="write">Write</Checkbox>
  <Checkbox value="admin">Admin</Checkbox>
</CheckboxGroup>
```

---

### RadioGroup & Radio
```tsx
import { RadioGroup, Radio } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<RadioGroup label="Billing Cycle" defaultValue="monthly" orientation="horizontal">
  <Radio value="monthly">Monthly ($12/mo)</Radio>
  <Radio value="annual">Annual ($100/yr)</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

---

### Switch
```tsx
import { Switch } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Switch isSelected={isDarkMode} onChange={setIsDarkMode}>
  Dark Mode
</Switch>
```

---

### InputOTP
Segmented One-Time Password / 2FA code input.

```tsx
import {
  InputOTP,
  InputOTPGroup,
  InputOTPSlot,
  InputOTPSeparator,
  REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS
} from '@moul-dev/ui';

<InputOTP maxLength={6} pattern={REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS} value={code} onChange={setCode}>
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
</InputOTP>
```

---

## 5. Overlays & Dialogs

### Modal
Accessible dialog overlay.

```tsx
import {
  Modal,
  ModalOverlay,
  ModalDialog,
  ModalHeader,
  ModalBody,
  ModalFooter,
  Button
} from '@moul-dev/ui';

<ModalOverlay isOpen={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen} isDismissable>
  <Modal size="md">
    <ModalDialog>
      <ModalHeader>
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Invite Team Member</h3>
      </ModalHeader>
      <ModalBody>
        <p className="text-sm text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">
          Enter the email address of the person you would like to invite.
        </p>
      </ModalBody>
      <ModalFooter>
        <Button variant="outline" onPress={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="primary" onPress={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Send Invitation</Button>
      </ModalFooter>
    </ModalDialog>
  </Modal>
</ModalOverlay>
```

---

### AlertDialog
Pre-composed confirmation and destructive dialogs.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<AlertDialog
  isOpen={showDelete}
  onOpenChange={setShowDelete}
  variant="destructive"
  title="Delete Database?"
  actionLabel="Delete Permanently"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  onAction={handleDelete}
>
  This action is permanent and cannot be undone. All database snapshots will be deleted.
</AlertDialog>
```

---

### Popover & Tooltip
```tsx
import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverDialog, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, Button } from '@moul-dev/ui';

// Tooltip
<TooltipTrigger delay={150}>
  <Button variant="ghost" aria-label="Copy">📋</Button>
  <Tooltip>Copy to clipboard</Tooltip>
</TooltipTrigger>

// Popover
<PopoverTrigger>
  <Button variant="outline">Options</Button>
  <Popover placement="bottom start">
    <PopoverDialog>
      <div className="p-3">Popover content</div>
    </PopoverDialog>
  </Popover>
</PopoverTrigger>
```

---

## 6. Feedback & Status

### Alert
Inline notification banners with 5 semantic variants.

```tsx
import { Alert } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Alert variant="info" title="System Maintenance">
  Scheduled maintenance will occur on Sunday at 02:00 UTC.
</Alert>

<Alert variant="error" title="Payment Failed">
  Your credit card could not be charged. Please update your payment method.
</Alert>
```

---

### Badge & Avatar
```tsx
import { Badge, Avatar } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
<Badge variant="danger" size="sm">Suspended</Badge>

<Avatar
  src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=150"
  alt="Jordan Lee"
  initials="JL"
  size="md"
  status="online"
/>
```

---

### Toast System
```tsx
import { ToastContainer, toastQueue, Button } from '@moul-dev/ui';

// 1. Place ToastContainer once at root:
<ToastContainer />

// 2. Dispatch toasts anywhere:
toastQueue.add({
  title: 'Profile Updated',
  description: 'Your profile changes were saved successfully.',
  variant: 'success',
  timeout: 4000,
});
```

---

## 7. Navigation & Layout

### Card
```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, Button } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Card variant="outlined">
  <CardHeader>
    <h3 className="font-semibold text-base">Server Cluster</h3>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>
    <p className="text-sm text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">
      Running 4 pods with 99.99% uptime.
    </p>
  </CardBody>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button variant="outline" size="sm">View Metrics</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

---

### Tabs
```tsx
import { Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanels, TabPanel } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Tabs defaultSelectedKey="tab1">
  <TabList aria-label="Settings navigation">
    <Tab id="tab1">General</Tab>
    <Tab id="tab2">Security</Tab>
    <Tab id="tab3">Billing</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanels>
    <TabPanel id="tab1">General settings content</TabPanel>
    <TabPanel id="tab2">Security settings content</TabPanel>
    <TabPanel id="tab3">Billing settings content</TabPanel>
  </TabPanels>
</Tabs>
```

---

### Table
```tsx
import { Table, TableHeader, Column, TableBody, Row, Cell } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Table aria-label="Orders table" selectionMode="single">
  <TableHeader>
    <Column isRowHeader>Order ID</Column>
    <Column>Customer</Column>
    <Column>Total</Column>
    <Column>Status</Column>
  </TableHeader>
  <TableBody>
    <Row id="ord-1">
      <Cell>#10492</Cell>
      <Cell>Alex Rivera</Cell>
      <Cell>$340.00</Cell>
      <Cell>Shipped</Cell>
    </Row>
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

---

### TagGroup
```tsx
import { TagGroup, Tag } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<TagGroup label="Skills" selectionMode="multiple">
  <Tag id="react">React</Tag>
  <Tag id="ts">TypeScript</Tag>
  <Tag id="stylex">StyleX</Tag>
</TagGroup>
```

---

## 8. Application Blocks

### Sidebar
Full collapsible sidebar navigation block with icons, groups, collapse toggle, and glassmorphic styling.

```tsx
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarAside,
  SidebarMain,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarItem,
  SidebarDivider,
  SidebarFooter
} from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Sidebar selectedKey={activeRoute} onSelectionChange={setActiveRoute}>
  <SidebarAside>
    <SidebarHeader>
      <h2 className="font-bold text-lg">App Console</h2>
    </SidebarHeader>
    <SidebarGroup title="Overview">
      <SidebarItem id="home">Dashboard</SidebarItem>
      <SidebarItem id="analytics">Analytics</SidebarItem>
    </SidebarGroup>
    <SidebarDivider />
    <SidebarFooter>
      <span>v2026.08.17</span>
    </SidebarFooter>
  </SidebarAside>
  <SidebarMain>
    <main className="p-6">Page Content</main>
  </SidebarMain>
</Sidebar>
```

---

## 9. Analytics & Charts

### AreaChart & LineChart
```tsx
import { ChartContainer, AreaChart } from '@moul-dev/ui';

const data = [
  { month: 'Jan', revenue: 4000, cost: 2400 },
  { month: 'Feb', revenue: 6000, cost: 3200 },
  { month: 'Mar', revenue: 8500, cost: 4100 },
];

<ChartContainer title="Revenue Growth" description="Monthly financial comparison">
  <AreaChart
    data={data}
    index="month"
    categories={['revenue', 'cost']}
    valueFormatter={(v) => `$${v}`}
    height={260}
  />
</ChartContainer>
```

### BarChart & DoughnutChart
```tsx
import { BarChart, DoughnutChart } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<BarChart
  data={data}
  index="month"
  categories={['revenue']}
  valueFormatter={(v) => `$${v}`}
/>

<DoughnutChart
  data={[
    { name: 'Direct', value: 45 },
    { name: 'Referral', value: 30 },
    { name: 'Organic', value: 25 },
  ]}
  index="name"
  category="value"
  variant="donut"
  valueFormatter={(v) => `${v}%`}
/>
```

### Stat, TopList, Percentage
```tsx
import { Stat, TopList, PercentageBar, PercentageCircle } from '@moul-dev/ui';

<Stat
  label="Conversion Rate"
  value="3.42%"
  change="+0.8%"
  changeType="positive"
  description="vs last 30 days"
/>

<TopList
  items={[
    { name: 'United States', value: '45,200', change: '+12%' },
    { name: 'Germany', value: '18,400', change: '+8%' },
  ]}
/>

<PercentageBar value={68} max={100} label="CPU Utilization" />
<PercentageCircle value={94} max={100} label="System Health" />
```

---

## 10. Theming & StyleX Design Tokens

### CSS Custom Properties
```css
:root {
  --brand-hue: 250;                 /* 0 - 360 */
  --brand-chroma-multiplier: 1.0;   /* 0.0 - 2.0 */
  --brand-density-factor: 1.0;      /* 0.8 (compact) to 1.25 (spacious) */
  --brand-radius-factor: 1.0;       /* 0 (sharp) to 2.0 (round) */
  --brand-font-scale: 1.0;          /* 0.9 to 1.1 */
}
```
